Phuket

Phuket is an airport with beaches attached. Stay on the west coast. Use Patong for a night if you want it, not as a four-night base.

AndamanHKTPhi Phi boats
SeasonBest November to April
AirportHKT, then 45-90 minutes by car
BoatsPhi Phi and Krabi in the morning

Kamala, Surin, and Bang Tao are calmer than Patong. Kata and Karon sit in the middle. Old Phuket Town is a morning of sino-portuguese streets if you need a non-beach day.

Beach clubs (Catch, Cafe del Mar) live on the Phuket nightlife page. Amanpuri and Avista Hideaway sit under resort living.

Common questions

Is Phuket a first-trip must?
It is the easy Andaman airport. Krabi is prettier on the water. Samui is the Gulf alternative when the Andaman is in monsoon.
How many nights?
Three on one beach. Add a fourth only if you want a boat day and a recovery day.
